name: Estegoanálisis (Detección de Datos Ocultos)
description: Detecta hidden data embedded en imágenes through steganographic techniques, indicando potential manipulación.
algorithm: Rich Model Steganálisis with Spatial Domain Features
mechanism: Extrae high-dimensional característica sets from spatial residuals using multiple filter kernels. Analiza estadístico properties disrupted when data is hidden in LSBs or transform coeficientes.
parameters: Feature dimension: 34671 (full SRM), Filters: 30 linear + nonlinear, Quantization: T=1,2,3, Classifier: ensemble
source: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting hidden payloads en imágenes that may indicate data exfiltration or tamper concealment

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Extremely high-dimensional características
• Covers wide range of embedding methods
• State-of-the-art detección rates
• Generalizes a través de steganographic algorithms
limitations:
• Very high computational cost
• Requires training data per embedding rate
• Large característica vectors need dimensionality reduction
• May produce falsos positivos on noisy images
